sections.title: Recognize the situation
points: New confusion, increasing respiratory rate, hypotension and falling urine output can be early deterioration signals.
An early-warning score organizes observations but does not replace clinical judgment or escalation when staff are concerned.

sections.title: Clinical decisions & differential
points: Recheck observations, glucose, oxygenation, medications and likely triggers while activating a rapid response pathway as indicated.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not dismiss a patient's worsening status because a single score is below an alert threshold.

quiz.question: Which change is a relevant ward deterioration warning?
quiz.explanation: New confusion with tachypnea. New confusion, increasing respiratory rate, hypotension and falling urine output can be early deterioration signals.
